answer: An agent marketplace requires each identity to lock $100 for 30 days before bidding, with one active bid per identity. This makes the cost of a sybil swarm crystal clear: 1,000 bidding identities require $100,000 immobilized for a month. Through the prism of capital allocation, fake accounts lose their cheap advantage; each extra identity creates a ripple of financing costs, even if the attacker recovers every deposit.
